info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_E-Branch Operations API
info.description: The E-Branch Operations API enables businesses to access and manage various e-branch functionalities seamlessly. This API provides endpoints for retrieving information related to specific e-branch operations, allowing consumers to enhance their banking channels. Typical users include financial institutions and developers who need to integrate e-branch capabilities into their applications. Through this API, users can efficiently query operational details, improving customer service and operational transparency.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific e-branch operation by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific e-branch operation using its unique identifier. It is useful for obtaining operational details and status about a particular resource.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving specific e-branch operations associated with the given resource identifier. This request can be used to fetch details and perform actions related to the e-branch operations.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested data.

GetEbranchOperationByIdRequest.description: A request body for the operations GET request for a specific branch, formatted as a JSON string.

GetEbranchOperationByIdResponse_200.title: Channel Specific Branch Operations Response

channelId.description: The unique identifier for the channel.

regionCode.description: The code corresponding to the region of the branch.

serviceWindow.description: The service window timings for the branch.

dailyCapacity.description: The daily capacity for operational throughput at the branch.

branchId.description: The unique identifier for the branch.

branchType.description: The type of the branch (e.g., retail, online, etc.).

timeZone.description: The time zone in which the branch operates.

recordStatus.description: The status of the recorded branch information.

version.description: The version of the branch information record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the branch information was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the branch response.
